parts/entry.mjs builds the portico (polished diorite floor, quartz steps, four columns, entablature with slab ceiling, two hanging lamps), the entry door with sidelights and fanlight, the Palladian with arch row and sill, three carriage doors with headers, and coach lights at x33, x37, x41.
Last make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt; my part placed 214 blocks with no refused writes, no off-palette blocks and no floating blocks; front and portico close-ups read as a columned portico over a glazed entry, with carriage doors and lanterns on the garage front.
plan.md checklist ticks P3; elements.md has a P3 section ticking E6, E7, E8, E9, E16 and E38 (partial); plan.md Notes records the x29 refusal.
left: Coach light at x29 z12 (E16) not built: (29,3..4,12) is the main house's east wall from P1, which is locked, so the write was refused. Skipped; P1 would need to open that cell or accept three lights.
E38 back sconces at (15,4,26) and (18,4,26) belong to P6 (finish), not built here.

Structural check on the full build.nbt reports 7 orphan smooth_quartz cells at y7 (x8,9,24,26,36,42) that are not from this part; they come from the shell/roof layer and should be checked by P1 or P2.
